meta.note: source_status: 'cited' = a source/citation was recorded; 'unverified' = no original source found (all AZQuotes entries are unverified, and some may be misattributed or paraphrased). Batch 2+ text was gathered via WebFetch page summaries, not raw page text, so spot-check wording against the linked page before publishing.

quotes.author: Miles Davis
quotes.quote: I'll play it and tell you what it is later.
quotes.source: Szwed, So What: The Life of Miles Davis (2012)

quotes.author: Miles Davis
quotes.quote: You can't play anything on a horn that Louis hasn't played.
quotes.source: The Jazz Review, interview with Nat Hentoff (1958)

quotes.author: Miles Davis
quotes.quote: My ego only needs a good rhythm section.
quotes.source: Milestones: The Music and Times of Miles Davis Since 1960 (1983)

quotes.author: Miles Davis
quotes.quote: For me, music and life are all about style.
quotes.source: Miles: The Autobiography (1989)

quotes.author: Miles Davis
quotes.quote: When you are creating your own shit, man, even the sky ain't the limit.
quotes.source: Miles (1990)

quotes.author: Louis Armstrong
quotes.quote: Love baby, love. That's the secret, yeah.
quotes.source: Spoken intro to "What a Wonderful World" (1970)

quotes.author: Louis Armstrong
quotes.quote: If you still have to ask, shame on you.
quotes.source: Max Jones et al., Salute to Satchmo (1970)

quotes.author: Louis Armstrong
quotes.quote: The way they're treating my people in the South, the government can go to hell.
quotes.source: The New York Times (19 September 1957)

quotes.author: Duke Ellington
quotes.quote: Music is an aural art. Until you hear it, it is not music.
quotes.source: Look (10 August 1954)

quotes.author: Duke Ellington
quotes.quote: Every man prays in his own language.
quotes.source: A Concert of Sacred Music (1965)

quotes.author: Duke Ellington
quotes.quote: I live a life of primitivity with the mind of a child.
quotes.source: Music Is My Mistress (1973)

quotes.author: Duke Ellington
quotes.quote: There are simply two kinds of music, good music and the other kind.

quotes.author: Duke Ellington
quotes.quote: My band is my instrument more than the piano.

quotes.author: Duke Ellington
quotes.quote: If it sounds good it's successful; if it doesn't it has failed.

quotes.author: Thelonious Monk
quotes.quote: You can't make anything go anywhere. It just happens.
quotes.source: Jet (31 March 1960)

quotes.author: Thelonious Monk
quotes.quote: All musicians are subconsciously mathematicians.
quotes.source: Down Beat (28 October 1971)

quotes.author: Thelonious Monk
quotes.quote: Keep breathing.
quotes.source: Interview (details not specified)

quotes.author: John Coltrane
quotes.quote: My goal is to live the truly religious life and express it in my music.
quotes.source: Newsweek (12 December 1966)

quotes.author: John Coltrane
quotes.quote: You can't separate the means that a man uses to say something from what he ultimately says.
quotes.source: Interview with Ralph J. Gleason, DownBeat (1961)

quotes.author: John Coltrane
quotes.quote: A musician would like to give a picture to the listener of the many wonderful things he knows of and senses in the universe.
quotes.source: DownBeat (12 April 1962), 'John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy Answer the Jazz Critics'

quotes.author: Charles Mingus
quotes.quote: Making the simple complicated is commonplace; making the complicated simple, awesomely simple, that's creativity.
quotes.source: Mainliner (July 1977)

quotes.author: Charles Mingus
quotes.quote: In my music, I'm trying to play the truth of what I am. The reason it's difficult is because I'm changing all the time.
quotes.source: Statement to Nat Hentoff

quotes.author: Charles Mingus
quotes.quote: My music is alive and it's about the living and the dead, about good and evil.
quotes.source: Open Letter to Miles Davis (1955)

quotes.author: Charles Mingus
quotes.quote: Each jazz musician when he takes a horn in his hand is taking the place of a composer.
quotes.source: Let My Children Hear Music (1971)

quotes.author: Charles Mingus
quotes.quote: I always wanted to be a spontaneous composer.
quotes.source: Let My Children Hear Music (1971)

quotes.author: Bill Evans
quotes.quote: Music should enrich the soul; it should teach spirituality.

quotes.author: Bill Evans
quotes.quote: The improvising musical group needs its framework in time.

quotes.author: Bill Evans
quotes.quote: I quickly tire of it, and I want to get back to the acoustic piano.
quotes.source: Interview with Les Tomkins (1972)

quotes.author: Billie Holiday
quotes.quote: No two people on earth are alike, and it's got to be music or it isn't music.
quotes.source: Lady Sings the Blues, ch. 4

quotes.author: Billie Holiday
quotes.quote: I can't stand to sing the same song the same way two nights in succession.
quotes.source: Lady Sings the Blues, ch. 4

quotes.author: Billie Holiday
quotes.quote: I've been told that nobody sings the word 'hunger' like I do. Or the word 'love.'
quotes.source: Lady Sings the Blues, ch. 22

quotes.author: Billie Holiday
quotes.quote: I'm always making a comeback but nobody ever tells me where I've been.
quotes.source: Lady Sings the Blues, ch. 23

quotes.author: Art Blakey
quotes.quote: If you make a mistake, make it loud so you won't make it next time.
quotes.source: Attributed; A Night in Tunisia album context

quotes.author: Art Blakey
quotes.quote: We are here to have a ball.
quotes.source: Live performance remark (not specified)

quotes.author: Art Blakey
quotes.quote: Leave your worldly troubles outside and come in here and swing.
quotes.source: Live performance remark (not specified)

quotes.author: Art Blakey
quotes.quote: If you feel like tapping your feet, tap your feet.
quotes.source: Live performance remark (not specified)

quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis
quotes.quote: The first jazz musician was a trumpeter, Buddy Bolden, and the last will be a trumpeter, the archangel Gabriel.

quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis
quotes.quote: Flexibility is an essential part of Jazz. It's what gives Jazz music the ability to combine with all other types of music and not lose its identity.

quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis
quotes.quote: I think that virtuosity is the first sign of morality in a musician. It means you're serious enough to practice.

quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis
quotes.quote: The reason why the music is important is that it's an art form, an ancient art form, that takes in the mythology of our people.

quotes.author: Eric Dolphy
quotes.quote: Music is a reflection of everything. And it's universal.
quotes.source: DownBeat (12 April 1962), 'John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy Answer the Jazz Critics'

quotes.author: Eric Dolphy
quotes.quote: It's like you have no idea what you're going to do next.
quotes.source: DownBeat (12 April 1962), 'John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy Answer the Jazz Critics'

quotes.author: Keith Jarrett
quotes.quote: Jumping off a cliff takes two hands and two feet.
quotes.source: DownBeat, 'At Home with Keith Jarrett' (21 March 2023)

quotes.author: Keith Jarrett
quotes.quote: Nobody who plays music can actually say why they did something.
quotes.source: DownBeat, 'At Home with Keith Jarrett' (21 March 2023)

quotes.author: Christian McBride
quotes.quote: Jazz is the second music of our lives. The first music of our lives is soul and rhythm-and-blues.
quotes.source: DownBeat, 'Blindfold Test: Christian McBride' (29 August 2023)

quotes.author: Christian McBride
quotes.quote: I love music that kisses the curb, like it's about to go off the road but it doesn't.
quotes.source: DownBeat, 'Blindfold Test: Christian McBride' (29 August 2023)

quotes.author: Christian McBride
quotes.quote: When you're young and you're hungry, you eat too fast.
quotes.source: DownBeat, 'Blindfold Test: Christian McBride' (29 August 2023)

quotes.author: Christian McBride
quotes.quote: I don't care where my place is — I just love playing.
quotes.source: DownBeat, 'Blindfold Test: Christian McBride' (29 August 2023)

quotes.author: Charles McPherson
quotes.quote: He's constructing intelligent musical sentences that connect seamlessly, which is the most important part of linear playing.
quotes.source: DownBeat, 'Blindfold Test: Charles McPherson' (27 February 2024)

quotes.author: Kit Downes
quotes.quote: It's that fine-line balance between self and other, which is the really fun thing about being an improviser.
quotes.source: DownBeat, 'Kit Downes Strikes a Balance' (22 July 2019)

quotes.author: Kit Downes
quotes.quote: The ongoing musical relationship I have with Tom is the key part of everything I do.
quotes.source: DownBeat, 'Kit Downes Strikes a Balance' (22 July 2019)

quotes.author: Fred Anderson
quotes.quote: Music is a mystery and you've got to keep exploring, just like anything else.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Fred Anderson: On the Run, 18 Jun 2005

quotes.author: Fred Anderson
quotes.quote: You just gotta get out here, and work, and commit yourself. Persevere.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Fred Anderson: On the Run, 18 Jun 2005

quotes.author: Fred Anderson
quotes.quote: My role in the city is to keep young musicians playing. I will always have a place for them to play.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Fred Anderson: On the Run, 18 Jun 2005

quotes.author: Joey DeFrancesco
quotes.quote: The longer you play, the more you're gonna sound like yourself with your own 'voice.'
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Joey DeFrancesco: From Musical Prodigy to Jazz Icon, 29 May 2019

quotes.author: Joey DeFrancesco
quotes.quote: One of the biggest ways to sound like yourself is to keep listening to everyone else.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Joey DeFrancesco: From Musical Prodigy to Jazz Icon, 29 May 2019

quotes.author: Joey DeFrancesco
quotes.quote: Music is a spiritual experience to begin with. And as you grow and go on in life, spirituality is going to affect whatever you do.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Joey DeFrancesco: From Musical Prodigy to Jazz Icon, 29 May 2019

quotes.author: Dave Weckl
quotes.quote: If you are the only one on stage having a good time with and understanding what you are playing, there's a problem.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Dave Weckl: On Time, 19 Dec 2012

quotes.author: Femi Koleoso
quotes.quote: The only reason you need a leader is because it allows for everyone else to be busy.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Ezra Collective's Femi Koleoso: On Tony Allen and UK jazz today, 13 Mar 2023

quotes.author: Femi Koleoso
quotes.quote: When great music is getting made it does get heard eventually, it can take a little while.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Ezra Collective's Femi Koleoso: On Tony Allen and UK jazz today, 13 Mar 2023

quotes.author: Tony Coe
quotes.quote: The first prerequisite is that it should be honest. Then you think about the craft and construction.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, Tony Coe: 'The first prerequisite is that it should be honest', 20 Mar 2023

quotes.author: Tony Coe
quotes.quote: I'm not really in favour of blackboard teaching of jazz at all.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, Tony Coe: 'The first prerequisite is that it should be honest', 20 Mar 2023

quotes.author: Tony Coe
quotes.quote: There are wrong notes in jazz. They say there are no wrong notes—well, there are.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, Tony Coe: 'The first prerequisite is that it should be honest', 20 Mar 2023

quotes.author: Stephane Grappelli
quotes.quote: It's not a question of old or modern. Nothing is old in music.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, JJ 04/81: Stephane Grappelli - From The Heart, 29 Apr 2021 (reprint)

quotes.author: Stephane Grappelli
quotes.quote: I never practice, I hate that.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, JJ 04/81: Stephane Grappelli - From The Heart, 29 Apr 2021 (reprint)

quotes.author: Stephane Grappelli
quotes.quote: You see, it's not me that's playing. It's the people who play with me that make me play.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, JJ 04/81: Stephane Grappelli - From The Heart, 29 Apr 2021 (reprint)

quotes.author: Allan Holdsworth
quotes.quote: I never really wanted to play guitar. I always wanted to play like a horn.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, JJ 05/92: Allan Holdsworth - the reluctant guitarist in conversation with Mark Gilbert, 31 May 2022 (reprint)

quotes.author: Allan Holdsworth
quotes.quote: It's the music that counts. It's a true understanding of the music rather than a formula.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, JJ 05/92: Allan Holdsworth - the reluctant guitarist in conversation with Mark Gilbert, 31 May 2022 (reprint)

quotes.author: Allan Holdsworth
quotes.quote: There's no point in practising anything in the open position. Don't play any open strings ever.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, JJ 05/92: Allan Holdsworth - the reluctant guitarist in conversation with Mark Gilbert, 31 May 2022 (reprint)

quotes.author: Marvin Stamm
quotes.quote: The thing that these people have which makes their music so viable for me is a feeling in the heart.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, JJ 03/91: Marvin Stamm interviewed, 31 Mar 2021 (reprint)

quotes.author: Marvin Stamm
quotes.quote: At no time in my life have I experienced anything like that band. Thad Jones was probably the most creative jazz musician I've ever known.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, JJ 03/91: Marvin Stamm interviewed, 31 Mar 2021 (reprint)

quotes.author: Mike Lee
quotes.quote: Jazz is a language. Too many students are confused by the term 'improvising.'
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Take Five With Mike Lee, 1 Mar 2011

quotes.author: Mike Lee
quotes.quote: I believe in a big sound with a lot of warmth. The key is plenty of air!
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Take Five With Mike Lee, 1 Mar 2011

quotes.author: Mike Lee
quotes.quote: People who gage the health of jazz by record sales are missing the point.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Take Five With Mike Lee, 1 Mar 2011

quotes.author: Meilana Gillard
quotes.quote: I was burnt out. It got too much for me and I just had to leave.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, Meilana Gillard - a story to tell, 25 Sep 2023

quotes.author: George Wein
quotes.quote: To me Pee Wee Russell personifies the jazz musician – he is the soul of true jazz.
quotes.source: Jazz Journal, JJ 09/61: In My Opinion - George Wein, 28 Sep 2021 (reprint)

quotes.author: Jan Lundgren
quotes.quote: Jazz isn't at all like other genres. Jazz encourages you to vary yourself as much as possible.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Jan Lundgren On Storytelling In Jazz Improvisation, 2 May 2025

quotes.author: Jan Lundgren
quotes.quote: Tennis is the same. As soon as you hit the ball, you don't know what's going to happen.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Jan Lundgren On Storytelling In Jazz Improvisation, 2 May 2025

quotes.author: Jan Lundgren
quotes.quote: In a good world, the musician's brain should control what the fingers do.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Jan Lundgren On Storytelling In Jazz Improvisation, 2 May 2025

quotes.author: Jacob Young
quotes.quote: The writing has always been the most important aspect of my records. The melodies and tunes are what I look for.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Jacob Young: Lyricism and Elasticity, 14 Sep 2004

quotes.author: Jacob Young
quotes.quote: Jim talked a lot about playing the melody, trying to improvise and stick to an idea thematically.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Jacob Young: Lyricism and Elasticity, 14 Sep 2004

quotes.author: Walt Weiskopf
quotes.quote: I'm just trying to write good music.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Walt Weiskopf: All About the Sound, 31 Mar 2016

quotes.author: Walt Weiskopf
quotes.quote: I always say it's kind of like your children. It's hard to have a favorite.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Walt Weiskopf: All About the Sound, 31 Mar 2016

quotes.author: Jeremy Udden
quotes.quote: It's jazz because of the process that the music is made with, and that the musicians making it are trained jazz musicians.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Jeremy Udden: Far From Plain, 17 Oct 2011

quotes.author: Gary Bartz
quotes.quote: The job of a musician is to hear that which no one else can hear.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Gary Bartz At 80: On Jazz Is Dead, Miles Davis And Why Improvisation Is A Dirty Word, 5 May 2021

quotes.author: Marialy Pacheco
quotes.quote: I decided I was going to play like I normally play. This is me, and I'm not going to pretend that I'm somebody else.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Marialy Pacheco: A Sunshine State of Mind, 4 Sep 2012

quotes.author: Marialy Pacheco
quotes.quote: The essence of jazz—improvisation—gives you freedom. It gives you the freedom to play from your heart and be creative.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Marialy Pacheco: A Sunshine State of Mind, 4 Sep 2012

quotes.author: Hans Ulrik
quotes.quote: It is such an expressive instrument. All those colors, all the emotions.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Hans Ulrik: Still Searching, 13 Mar 2014

quotes.author: Roswell Rudd
quotes.quote: All music starts with improvisation. So, if you didn't have the improvisers, you wouldn't have the rest of it.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Roswell Rudd: Where Improvisation Lives

quotes.author: Roswell Rudd
quotes.quote: The collective improvisation was the thing that was common both to Dixieland music and the so-called avant-garde music of the '60s.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Roswell Rudd: Where Improvisation Lives

quotes.author: Vic Juris
quotes.quote: A good jazz band is like the Harlem Globetrotters when they get in a circle and throw the ball around to Sweet Georgia Brown.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Vic Juris: Tension and Release, 2 Jan 2020

quotes.author: John Escreet
quotes.quote: You've just got to be open-minded and welcoming to new things. You've got to be embracing of any good music.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, John Escreet: Music for This Age, 22 Aug 2011

quotes.author: John Escreet
quotes.quote: The real goal is to basically create your own genre, without wanting to sound too pretentious or anything.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, John Escreet: Music for This Age, 22 Aug 2011

quotes.author: John Escreet
quotes.quote: If you create your own thing and it's so strong that people can't argue with that, you'll work for the rest of your life.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, John Escreet: Music for This Age, 22 Aug 2011

quotes.author: John McNeil
quotes.quote: You've got some stuff to learn, but you're already a player. That's number one.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Meet John McNeil, 19 May 2005

quotes.author: John McNeil
quotes.quote: There's never a shortage of people to tell you what you can't do. Your job is not to listen to them.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Meet John McNeil, 19 May 2005

quotes.author: John McNeil
quotes.quote: When you play an idea you have to work with it—move it around, change keys, change it up rhythmically.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Meet John McNeil, 19 May 2005

quotes.author: Ray Scro
quotes.quote: A large part of the joy of teaching is the inquisitive energy I get from students.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Ray Scro: What Jazz Education Means, 16 Aug 2011

quotes.author: Ernie Watts
quotes.quote: I just think it's important to share; that's what the music is about, that's how the music evolves and that's how the music stays alive.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Ernie Watts: Flying High, 11 Sep 2007

quotes.author: Ernie Watts
quotes.quote: Freedom through discipline. You can't break the rules until you know the rules.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Ernie Watts: Flying High, 11 Sep 2007

quotes.author: Danny Gottlieb
quotes.quote: I've listened to so many recordings of so many different drummers over the years, and still do today.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Meet Drummer Danny Gottlieb, 16 Mar 2024

quotes.author: Danny Gottlieb
quotes.quote: No regrets at all! I'm just happy to be a part of the jazz music world, and happy to be making a living doing it!
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Meet Drummer Danny Gottlieb, 16 Mar 2024

quotes.author: John Riley
quotes.quote: This is a fluid, evolving endeavor, and I'm always looking at new trends and how they relate to what happened in the past.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, John Riley: Inspiring Innovation, 23 Jul 2014

quotes.author: Denise King
quotes.quote: You don't need vocal gymnastics or pyrotechnics, just tell the story. The person who penned the particular song was telling a story.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Denise King: Making the Tradition New, 23 Jul 2015

quotes.author: Denise King
quotes.quote: The Universe speaks, and you have to be still to hear it. You have to go inside for direction and for clarity.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Denise King: Making the Tradition New, 23 Jul 2015

quotes.author: Julian Priester
quotes.quote: I loved music so much that I didn't care about making money, I just wanted to play.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Julian Priester: Reflections in Positivity, 8 Dec 2017

quotes.author: Esbjorn Svensson
quotes.quote: I compose from the heart. I've been inspired the last couple of years very much by classical music.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Esbjorn Svensson: What Jazz Is, Not Was, 29 Nov 2004

quotes.author: Esbjorn Svensson
quotes.quote: The challenge for us is to continue working with the acoustic picture and keep the music interesting in that frame.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Esbjorn Svensson: What Jazz Is, Not Was, 29 Nov 2004

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: Music is a thing you never completely master; there's always new things coming up anyway.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Sonny Rollins: Still a Student

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: I consider myself still a student.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Sonny Rollins: Still a Student

quotes.author: Yazz Ahmed
quotes.quote: Jazz is a very conversational type of music which makes sharing your ideas and stories very natural.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, Yazz Ahmed: The Inclusive Saboteuse, 5 Mar 2020

quotes.author: James Brandon Lewis
quotes.quote: I have a fear and that is becoming complacent, which is why I am always studying and pushing things further.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, The Unstoppable James Brandon Lewis, 12 May 2021

quotes.author: James Brandon Lewis
quotes.quote: Music should maybe be just an experience that touches the heart bathed in the vibe of the moment.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, The Unstoppable James Brandon Lewis, 12 May 2021

quotes.author: James Brandon Lewis
quotes.quote: I believe that jazz is a continuum that continually adds to its fabric the multitudes of ways we can think of music.
quotes.source: All About Jazz, The Unstoppable James Brandon Lewis, 12 May 2021

quotes.author: Marilyn Crispell
quotes.quote: I often talk with my students about thinking compositionally when improvising.
quotes.source: NEA, Notable Quotable: 2025 NEA Jazz Master Marilyn Crispell, March 27, 2025

quotes.author: Marilyn Crispell
quotes.quote: I like to think of it as a developing composition.
quotes.source: NEA, Notable Quotable: 2025 NEA Jazz Master Marilyn Crispell, March 27, 2025

quotes.author: Marilyn Crispell
quotes.quote: I think you can't separate them because you have a brain and a heart.
quotes.source: NEA, Notable Quotable: 2025 NEA Jazz Master Marilyn Crispell, March 27, 2025

quotes.author: Marilyn Crispell
quotes.quote: It's more like getting out of your own way and allowing that flow to happen.
quotes.source: NEA, Notable Quotable: 2025 NEA Jazz Master Marilyn Crispell, March 27, 2025

quotes.author: Dee Dee Bridgewater
quotes.quote: Singing is healing.
quotes.source: NEA, #WednesdayWisdom with 2017 NEA Jazz Masters, February 15, 2017

quotes.author: Dick Hyman
quotes.quote: I found out long ago that if you practice enough, every piano in town feels great.
quotes.source: NEA, #WednesdayWisdom with 2017 NEA Jazz Masters, February 15, 2017

quotes.author: Dave Holland
quotes.quote: Older players should play with younger players and vice-versa so we have a chance to cross-pollinate our influences and backgrounds.
quotes.source: NEA, #WednesdayWisdom with 2017 NEA Jazz Masters, February 15, 2017

quotes.author: Jamey Aebersold
quotes.quote: If you study music, it encourages you to listen.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Moments: Jamey Aebersold on listening to what's in your head, December 19, 2013

quotes.author: Jamey Aebersold
quotes.quote: I distinctly get the feeling they are not playing what they hear in their head.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Moments: Jamey Aebersold on listening to what's in your head, December 19, 2013

quotes.author: Jamey Aebersold
quotes.quote: It takes a lot of discipline for someone that's used to playin' to back up and go to the first grade, note-wise.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Moments: Jamey Aebersold on listening to what's in your head, December 19, 2013

quotes.author: Jamey Aebersold
quotes.quote: But if they'll do it, it'll pay them dividends the rest of their life.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Moments: Jamey Aebersold on listening to what's in your head, December 19, 2013

quotes.author: Dave Liebman
quotes.quote: In a certain way, education has become, to my mind, it's the life-line of the music now.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Moments: Dave Liebman on the importance of jazz education

quotes.author: Dave Liebman
quotes.quote: That this is my way of thanking Miles and Elvin, and Louis Armstrong, or whoever.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Moments: Dave Liebman on the importance of jazz education

quotes.author: Dave Liebman
quotes.quote: Passing this on is my job, our job.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Moments: Dave Liebman on the importance of jazz education

quotes.author: Lorraine Gordon
quotes.quote: Jazz can be hot, and everybody knows what that means if you like jazz.
quotes.source: NEA, Making a Place for Jazz, 2021

quotes.author: Lorraine Gordon
quotes.quote: There's a genius living in this town and you have to come and hear him.
quotes.source: NEA, Making a Place for Jazz, 2021

quotes.author: Jimmy Owens
quotes.quote: When I was three or four years old, my father used to pick me up and dance with me.
quotes.source: NEA, Making a Place for Jazz, 2021

quotes.author: Jimmy Heath
quotes.quote: You always have an idol or somebody that you're trying to sound like. But it evolves into your own sound, and it takes awhile.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Jimmy Heath

quotes.author: Jimmy Heath
quotes.quote: If you're an aggressive person, it comes out in your music.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Jimmy Heath

quotes.author: Jimmy Heath
quotes.quote: The big band is jazz music's symphony orchestra.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Jimmy Heath

quotes.author: Joanne Brackeen
quotes.quote: Before I get to the piano, I just feel something inside, and that's the music.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Joanne Brackeen

quotes.author: Joanne Brackeen
quotes.quote: What I heard was the sound of heaven and earth put together.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Joanne Brackeen

quotes.author: Hubert Laws
quotes.quote: You know, I never did stop practicing. Even today, I practice as much as I can every day.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Hubert Laws

quotes.author: Hubert Laws
quotes.quote: Being involved in jazz has helped me in many other ways in life, period.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Hubert Laws

quotes.author: Hubert Laws
quotes.quote: Music is a communicative tool.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Hubert Laws

quotes.author: Hubert Laws
quotes.quote: You can't really write jazz, you know. You use some themes and allow the musicians to make it their own.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Hubert Laws

quotes.author: George Benson
quotes.quote: I turned professional so early in life it's ridiculous.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: George Benson, interview August 2008

quotes.author: George Benson
quotes.quote: My favorite music's always been jazz music because it challenges me.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: George Benson, interview August 2008

quotes.author: Slide Hampton
quotes.quote: Everything that's really of quality requires a lot of work.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters interview: Slide Hampton, January 13, 2007

quotes.author: Slide Hampton
quotes.quote: Improvisation has always been important because it's always important in life.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters interview: Slide Hampton, January 13, 2007

quotes.author: Slide Hampton
quotes.quote: Your life experience is very important, not so much for your creativity, but especially for your expression.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters interview: Slide Hampton, January 13, 2007

quotes.author: Slide Hampton
quotes.quote: Arranging is a form of composition.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters interview: Slide Hampton, January 13, 2007

quotes.author: Jamey Aebersold
quotes.quote: I think I came up with the idea of a play-along out of desperation.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Jamey Aebersold

quotes.author: Jamey Aebersold
quotes.quote: Anybody can improvise if you show 'em what scale you're gonna play on and give 'em a little background.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Jamey Aebersold

quotes.author: Bobby Shew (quoted by Jamey Aebersold)
quotes.quote: If you want to compete, compete with that part of yourself that tends to be lazy.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Jamey Aebersold

quotes.author: Carla Bley
quotes.quote: I grab the tune by the horns, and just work on it all morning.
quotes.source: NEA, All That Jazz: A #JazzAppreciationMonth Podcast Round-up, 2018

quotes.author: Sheila Jordan
quotes.quote: You will find a place to sing if you really want it.
quotes.source: NEA, All That Jazz: A #JazzAppreciationMonth Podcast Round-up, 2018

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: The greatest thing in the world is to be playing your instrument. That's the greatest thing in the world because it's you and the universe.
quotes.source: NEA, All That Jazz: A #JazzAppreciationMonth Podcast Round-up, 2018

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: It's really been a transcendental experience whenever I play.
quotes.source: NEA Art Works Podcast interview with Josephine Reed, September 6, 2017

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: You are the music.
quotes.source: NEA Art Works Podcast interview with Josephine Reed, September 6, 2017

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: There's no such thing as enough. Because there's always more.
quotes.source: NEA Art Works Podcast interview with Josephine Reed, September 6, 2017

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: I'm grateful for having the chance to play the horn the times that I did.
quotes.source: NEA Art Works Podcast interview with Josephine Reed, September 6, 2017

quotes.author: Roy Haynes
quotes.quote: I try to do it by what I feel rather than talk about it.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Roy Haynes

quotes.author: Roy Haynes
quotes.quote: That was a very exciting period.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile: Roy Haynes

quotes.author: Sheila Jordan
quotes.quote: I'm going to dedicate myself to this music.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Sheila Jordan

quotes.author: Sheila Jordan
quotes.quote: I just want to be a messenger of the music.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Sheila Jordan

quotes.author: Sheila Jordan
quotes.quote: This music, I live with it 24 hours a day. It never leaves me, it's always with me.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Sheila Jordan

quotes.author: Dee Dee Bridgewater
quotes.quote: Don't listen to singers; listen to musicians. If you want to create your own style, that's what you have to do.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Dee Dee Bridgewater, March 31, 2017

quotes.author: Dee Dee Bridgewater
quotes.quote: Always sing your melody first. People need to know what the song is before you go into improvising.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Dee Dee Bridgewater, March 31, 2017

quotes.author: Dee Dee Bridgewater
quotes.quote: Learn your songs inside out, so you don't have to think about what you're singing.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Dee Dee Bridgewater, March 31, 2017

quotes.author: Dee Dee Bridgewater
quotes.quote: Everything that I know about music, I learned from Thad Jones, and I learned from being in that band.
quotes.source: NEA Jazz Masters profile and Art Works podcast: Dee Dee Bridgewater, March 31, 2017

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: The most important thing I got from my classical experience was how to make my practice times more valuable.
quotes.source: NEA Art Works Podcast: Ron Carter

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: If you're gonna be in this profession and not a hobbyist, you have to be willing to make some sacrifices.
quotes.source: NEA Art Works Podcast: Ron Carter

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: Every night's a great chance to play great music with some wonderful players, every night, any night.
quotes.source: NEA Art Works Podcast: Ron Carter

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: This is a job. We're really serious people here and take it seriously.
quotes.source: NEA Art Works Podcast: Ron Carter

quotes.author: Charlie Haden
quotes.quote: The artist is very lucky because in an art form that's spontaneous like that, that's when you really see your true self.
quotes.source: NPR, Fresh Air's summer music interviews: Jazz great Charlie Haden (Fresh Air, 1992 interview; 2022)

quotes.author: Charlie Haden
quotes.quote: One of the great things that improvising teaches you is the magic of the moment that you're in.
quotes.source: NPR, 'Live In The Present': Charlie Haden Remembered (Fresh Air, 2014)

quotes.author: Charlie Haden
quotes.quote: You have to see your unimportance before you can see your importance and your significance to the world.
quotes.source: NPR, 'Live In The Present': Charlie Haden Remembered (Fresh Air, 2014)

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: When I'm actually on the stage and performing, the optimum condition is not to think. I just want the music to play itself.
quotes.source: NPR, Remembering jazz giant Sonny Rollins (Fresh Air, 2026)

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: If I don't play my horn for a while, I get physically sick.
quotes.source: NPR, Remembering tenor saxophonist Sonny Rollins, a titan of modern jazz (Fresh Air, 1994 interview; 2026)

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: I learned that I had the strength to get over something, which was really deep.
quotes.source: NPR, Remembering tenor saxophonist Sonny Rollins, a titan of modern jazz (Fresh Air, 1994 interview; 2026)

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: I considered myself maybe — 80 percent self-taught. So I had a lot of instructional things for myself that enabled me to improvise.
quotes.source: NPR, After 7 Decades, Sonny Rollins Can't Get Music Off His Mind (June 12, 2017)

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: I have to have my basic material there. Then comes the next step, which is improvisation.
quotes.source: NPR, After 7 Decades, Sonny Rollins Can't Get Music Off His Mind (June 12, 2017)

quotes.author: Sonny Rollins
quotes.quote: I want to be a human being, a good human being. I need to always express that to young students.
quotes.source: NPR, After 7 Decades, Sonny Rollins Can't Get Music Off His Mind (June 12, 2017)

quotes.author: James Moody
quotes.quote: You want to really know what's happening, you learn the piano.
quotes.source: NPR, Fresh Air Remembers Saxophonist James Moody (Fresh Air, 1996 interview)

quotes.author: James Moody
quotes.quote: It's been very good to me, that solo. And I'm honored and privileged to be able to do it.
quotes.source: NPR, Fresh Air Remembers Saxophonist James Moody (Fresh Air, 1996 interview)

quotes.author: Herbie Hancock
quotes.quote: I'm looking to create the moment that I'm actually living in at that moment. And frankly, that's what jazz really is about anyway.
quotes.source: NPR, Interview: Herbie Hancock, Musician And Author Of 'Possibilities' (Fresh Air)

quotes.author: Herbie Hancock
quotes.quote: They're able to help you to discover your own truth.
quotes.source: NPR, Interview: Herbie Hancock, Musician And Author Of 'Possibilities' (Fresh Air)

quotes.author: Herbie Hancock
quotes.quote: He set me out on a path to find my own answer.
quotes.source: NPR, Interview: Herbie Hancock, Musician And Author Of 'Possibilities' (Fresh Air)

quotes.author: Herbie Hancock
quotes.quote: That's a very important lesson that I've learned and applied — not only to music, but I apply it to life.
quotes.source: NPR, Interview: Herbie Hancock On His Next Album, Flying Lotus And Jupiter (A Blog Supreme, Aug. 4, 2016)

quotes.author: Marian McPartland
quotes.quote: When you sit down to play, you should play as if it were the last day of your life, play as well as you can.
quotes.source: NPR, Fresh Air Remembers 'Piano Jazz' Host Marian McPartland (Fresh Air, 1987 interview)

quotes.author: Marian McPartland
quotes.quote: Everything I've done has been a springboard to do something else.
quotes.source: NPR, Fresh Air Remembers 'Piano Jazz' Host Marian McPartland (Fresh Air, 1987 interview)

quotes.author: Marian McPartland
quotes.quote: I just wanted to play better and listen to a lot of people, people I really loved—Bill Evans and horn players like Sonny Rollins.
quotes.source: NPR, Marian McPartland's Storied Life, Told 'In Good Time' (Fresh Air)

quotes.author: Marian McPartland
quotes.quote: He said, oh, you play so many notes. I thought he's obviously telling me I'm playing too many notes.
quotes.source: NPR, Marian McPartland's Storied Life, Told 'In Good Time' (Fresh Air)

quotes.author: Pharoah Sanders
quotes.quote: To me, it's all spiritual music. And it's all like one big prayer, you know, all the music.
quotes.source: NPR, Wade In The Water Ep. 22: Jazz And The Wider World Of The Sacred (Part II)

quotes.author: Delfeayo Marsalis
quotes.quote: There's a purpose for improvisation and you're trying to get a point across.
quotes.source: NPR, Wade In The Water Ep. 22: Jazz And The Wider World Of The Sacred (Part II)

quotes.author: John Gilmore
quotes.quote: All of Sun Ra's sounds were sacred.
quotes.source: NPR, Wade In The Water Ep. 22: Jazz And The Wider World Of The Sacred (Part II)

quotes.author: Jon Batiste
quotes.quote: I oftentimes think about music as life and just different examples of life, different ways that I see things.
quotes.source: NPR, Jon Batiste Shares Joy In A Painful Year: 'I Want To Reaffirm People's Humanity' (Fresh Air, 2021)

quotes.author: Jon Batiste
quotes.quote: I want to reaffirm people's humanity when it's been under such duress and when it's under attack.
quotes.source: NPR, Jon Batiste Shares Joy In A Painful Year: 'I Want To Reaffirm People's Humanity' (Fresh Air, 2021)

quotes.author: Marcus Miller
quotes.quote: Any really talented genius musician you meet have a little craziness going on.
quotes.source: NPR, Jaco Pastorius: 20 Years Later

quotes.author: Jessica Williams
quotes.quote: I discovered that the only right way is the way that works best for you.
quotes.source: NPR, Remembering jazz pianist and composer Jessica Williams (Fresh Air, 1997 interview; 2022)

quotes.author: Jessica Williams
quotes.quote: That's the most important part of the music, is the communication. That's what makes me the happiest.
quotes.source: NPR, Remembering jazz pianist and composer Jessica Williams (Fresh Air, 1997 interview; 2022)

quotes.author: Jessica Williams
quotes.quote: There's so many ways to play tunes. And the really great tunes you can do almost anything to.
quotes.source: NPR, Remembering jazz pianist and composer Jessica Williams (Fresh Air, 1997 interview; 2022)

quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis
quotes.quote: Music is the art of the invisible—it is memory, intention and imagination.
quotes.source: NPR, Wynton Marsalis Moves Jazz To 'Higher Ground' (2008)

quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis
quotes.quote: Great musicians demonstrate mutual respect and trust on the bandstand that can alter your outlook on the world.
quotes.source: NPR, Wynton Marsalis Moves Jazz To 'Higher Ground' (2008)

quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis
quotes.quote: All great music has rest in it.
quotes.source: NPR, Wynton Marsalis Moves Jazz To 'Higher Ground' (2008)

quotes.author: Terence Blanchard
quotes.quote: Don't try to say that jazz is this or jazz is that because it's neither. It's what you make it.
quotes.source: NPR, Trumpeter Terence Blanchard Performs Live in 4A (Talk of the Nation, 2007)

quotes.author: Terence Blanchard
quotes.quote: Sometimes when you think too much, you can think yourself into a hole and the music goes by you.
quotes.source: NPR, Trumpeter Terence Blanchard Performs Live in 4A (Talk of the Nation, 2007)

quotes.author: Terence Blanchard
quotes.quote: Sometimes when you're tired, that's the best thing for you, because your brain gets out of the way.
quotes.source: NPR, Trumpeter Terence Blanchard Performs Live in 4A (Talk of the Nation, 2007)

quotes.author: Joshua Redman
quotes.quote: In jazz, the music really becomes complete because it's a music of improvisation.
quotes.source: NPR, Joshua Redman, 'Back East' at Blues Alley (2007)

quotes.author: Joshua Redman
quotes.quote: The great responsibility that I feel has been to try to play music that's honest, creative, in the moment.
quotes.source: NPR, Joshua Redman, 'Back East' at Blues Alley (2007)

quotes.author: Joshua Redman
quotes.quote: There's nothing can substitute for a live performance.
quotes.source: NPR, Joshua Redman, 'Back East' at Blues Alley (2007)

quotes.author: Samara Joy
quotes.quote: I needed to control it more. It was either you sing soft or you sing loud.
quotes.source: NPR, Grammy-winning jazz singer Samara Joy joins for concert and conversation (May 29, 2023)

quotes.author: Samara Joy
quotes.quote: Every time I listen to a recording of hers it's like there was something special about it. There was something different.
quotes.source: NPR, Grammy-winning jazz singer Samara Joy joins for concert and conversation (May 29, 2023)

quotes.author: Samara Joy
quotes.quote: I'm looking forward to singing standards of a different era, but hopefully finding the work that will become standards.
quotes.source: NPR, Samara Joy, a young vocalist creating the standards of today (Sept. 1, 2022)

quotes.author: Cécile McLorin Salvant
quotes.quote: Early on, I started becoming really interested in these voices in jazz that were coming more from the tradition of blues and folk music.
quotes.source: NPR, The Vast, Versatile Range Of Cécile McLorin Salvant (Nov. 18, 2017)

quotes.author: Cécile McLorin Salvant
quotes.quote: I am so excited that there is so much in American music. There are so many different styles, and vibes and situations.
quotes.source: NPR, The Vast, Versatile Range Of Cécile McLorin Salvant (Nov. 18, 2017)

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: Age has not made me think slower. And it's not made me refuse gigs.
quotes.source: NPR, 85-year-old bassist Ron Carter has no plans on slowing down (May 4, 2022)

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: How did I help these guys play better? And how could I make me be better as I got them better?
quotes.source: NPR, 85-year-old bassist Ron Carter has no plans on slowing down (May 4, 2022)

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: Like most bass players, we always feel like nobody knows we're there. We're really back here doing something.
quotes.source: NPR, Hear bassist Ron Carter chat with host Christian McBride (May 4, 2022)

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: One of the fun things about being a bass player is you can make those kinds of things happen.
quotes.source: NPR, Ron Carter On Piano Jazz (Piano Jazz)

quotes.author: Jon-Erik Kellso
quotes.quote: I couldn't stand not sounding good, so I practiced incessantly when I was young.
quotes.source: NPR, Jazz band the EarRegulars stop in for live music and conversation (Nov. 22, 2023)

quotes.author: George Benson
quotes.quote: My life does not depend on what the next man is doing. It's what I do.
quotes.source: NPR, A conversation with jazz icon George Benson (Sept. 19, 2024)

quotes.author: Gerald Wilson
quotes.quote: I stay out of the way of the singer. I try to use great harmony for them and to make their voice sound better.
quotes.source: NPR, 'Fresh Air' Remembers Jazz Composer Gerald Wilson (Sept. 12, 2014)

quotes.author: Aaron Diehl
quotes.quote: She was constantly pushing herself, pushing the boundaries for herself as a musician.
quotes.source: NPR, Jazz musician Aaron Diehl on his rendition of 'The Zodiac Suite' (Jan. 7, 2024)

quotes.author: Aaron Diehl
quotes.quote: When you're dealing with 20, 30 musicians, there has to be some kind of roadmap.
quotes.source: NPR, Jazz musician Aaron Diehl on his rendition of 'The Zodiac Suite' (Jan. 7, 2024)

quotes.author: Esperanza Spalding
quotes.quote: A focused thirty minutes every day is more valuable than three hours a day, if you're scatterbrained.
quotes.source: JazzTimes, Esperanza Spalding: Grounded & Inspiring

quotes.author: Esperanza Spalding
quotes.quote: The more you study other soloists, harmony and singers, the less you have to translate.
quotes.source: JazzTimes, Esperanza Spalding: Grounded & Inspiring

quotes.author: Esperanza Spalding
quotes.quote: There's a form; there's a structure. Then you apply the theory to the sound.
quotes.source: JazzTimes, Esperanza Spalding: Grounded & Inspiring

quotes.author: Rhiannon
quotes.quote: Improvisation was a life skill. There is nowhere better to learn that than on the farm.
quotes.source: JazzTimes, Rhiannon: Total Improvisation

quotes.author: Rhiannon
quotes.quote: Improvisation is a useful skill in all music and vital in life.
quotes.source: JazzTimes, Rhiannon: Total Improvisation

quotes.author: Rhiannon
quotes.quote: I heard jazz for the first time and was hooked on the interplay, the improvisation, the capacity to choose second by second.
quotes.source: JazzTimes, Rhiannon: Total Improvisation

quotes.author: Adam Levy
quotes.quote: I always keep a notepad next to my computer. I take notes throughout the lesson—things that we may circle back to.
quotes.source: JazzTimes, 21st Century Lesson Plan: Learning Jazz Remotely

quotes.author: Greg Fishman
quotes.quote: We can never really play music together in real time.
quotes.source: JazzTimes, 21st Century Lesson Plan: Learning Jazz Remotely

quotes.author: David Gilmore
quotes.quote: I used to play along to records a lot without actually transcribing. I would just solo along with it.
quotes.source: JazzTimes, Before & After with David Gilmore

quotes.author: Dexter Gordon
quotes.quote: I would have to say it is Go!—the perfect rhythm section made it possible for me to play whatever I wanted to play.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, The Dozens: Dexter Gordon

quotes.author: Duke Ellington
quotes.quote: There are two kinds of music. Good music, and the other kind.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, The Dozens: Aaron Parks Selects 12 Essential Paul Bley Tracks

quotes.author: Jamey Aebersold
quotes.quote: I'm trying to force people to learn how to improvise.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jamey Aebersold, December 16, 2013

quotes.author: Jamey Aebersold
quotes.quote: The melody is not there on any of them.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jamey Aebersold, December 16, 2013

quotes.author: Kenny Burrell
quotes.quote: Music changed my attitude about what to look forward to, something positive.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Kenny Burrell, February 16-17, 2010

quotes.author: Kenny Burrell
quotes.quote: You could get your own sound if you try. That you don't have to sound like anybody else.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Kenny Burrell, February 16-17, 2010

quotes.author: Kenny Burrell
quotes.quote: This is music that deserves proper recognition, proper education, should be taught.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Kenny Burrell, February 16-17, 2010

quotes.author: Kenny Burrell
quotes.quote: The most important thing is to make the music happen and help them sound as good as possible.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Kenny Burrell, February 16-17, 2010

quotes.author: Benny Carter
quotes.quote: If you're going to be playing alto, you've got to learn to play in these keys.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Benny Carter, August 6-9, 1992

quotes.author: Benny Carter
quotes.quote: I just sat down and I'd start at the top of the page and see what would happen.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Benny Carter, August 6-9, 1992

quotes.author: Toshiko Akiyoshi
quotes.quote: I think it's one of the good things, I think about, is when you don't have a book, you're not learning from a book.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Toshiko Akiyoshi, June 29, 2008

quotes.author: Toshiko Akiyoshi
quotes.quote: Jazz is a social art: if you are surrounded by better players, you become better at it.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Toshiko Akiyoshi, June 29, 2008

quotes.author: Toshiko Akiyoshi
quotes.quote: I had a very good education, and music education, as well.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Toshiko Akiyoshi, June 29, 2008

quotes.author: Frank Foster
quotes.quote: Music is life. Every song that I compose relates to some phase, or element, or period, or passing moment of my life.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Frank Foster, September-November 1998

quotes.author: Frank Foster
quotes.quote: I just fell into the bebop thing, but in doing so I realize that the musicality and the validity of it was all there.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Frank Foster, September-November 1998

quotes.author: Dave Liebman
quotes.quote: This is not a hobby. What can I say? I'm still 15 years old.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Dave Liebman, January 4-5, 2011

quotes.author: Jimmy Scott
quotes.quote: It's got to mean something.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jimmy Scott, September 23-24, 2008

quotes.author: Jimmy Scott
quotes.quote: No turning back. I still had a job to do.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jimmy Scott, September 23-24, 2008

quotes.author: Melba Liston
quotes.quote: I just loved the instrument. I didn't need no inspiration.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Melba Liston, December 4-5, 1996

quotes.author: Melba Liston
quotes.quote: I write from my soul, and if it sounds like somebody, well it sounds like somebody.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Melba Liston, December 4-5, 1996

quotes.author: Melba Liston
quotes.quote: Study. Go to school and learn everything that you can in school, and don't stop there.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Melba Liston, December 4-5, 1996

quotes.author: Roy Haynes
quotes.quote: I stayed too long at the fair.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Roy Haynes, May 15, 1994

quotes.author: Roy Haynes
quotes.quote: We never rehearsed anything. Just went right in. It was beautiful.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Roy Haynes, May 15, 1994

quotes.author: Art Farmer
quotes.quote: I didn't have any idea of what the ingredients were required to play within the harmonic form of a piece.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Art Farmer, June 29-30, 1995

quotes.author: Art Farmer
quotes.quote: If you're trying to do something, you'll take advantage of any opportunity.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Art Farmer, June 29-30, 1995

quotes.author: Art Farmer
quotes.quote: If you don't know anything, keep your mouth closed and maybe you'll learn something.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Art Farmer, June 29-30, 1995

quotes.author: Jack DeJohnette
quotes.quote: I was drawn to music before I even realized I was really smitten by it.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jack DeJohnette, November 10-11, 2011

quotes.author: Jack DeJohnette
quotes.quote: It took me about a week just to get my independence on the drums, it somehow came natural to me.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jack DeJohnette, November 10-11, 2011

quotes.author: Jack DeJohnette
quotes.quote: I never saw music in terms of these compartmentalized concepts.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jack DeJohnette, November 10-11, 2011

quotes.author: Marian McPartland
quotes.quote: I always had that feeling. I'll never make it. I'm not good enough.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Marian McPartland, January 3-4, 1997 and May 26, 1998

quotes.author: Marian McPartland
quotes.quote: The melody sticks in my head to this day.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Marian McPartland, January 3-4, 1997 and May 26, 1998

quotes.author: Jackie McLean
quotes.quote: I'm 98% an ear musician and 2% a paper musician.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jackie McLean, July 20-21, 2001

quotes.author: Jackie McLean
quotes.quote: I help develop their concept by letting them experience what I experienced, what I heard, what I listened to.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jackie McLean, July 20-21, 2001

quotes.author: Johnny Mandel
quotes.quote: If it sounds good, it's the only criteria.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Johnny Mandel, April 20-21, 1995

quotes.author: Johnny Mandel
quotes.quote: I learned it by doing, 'cause I think that's really the only way you can learn it.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Johnny Mandel, April 20-21, 1995

quotes.author: Johnny Mandel
quotes.quote: The secret of this whole thing is to be able to look at the music through experience and know what it sounds like.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Johnny Mandel, April 20-21, 1995

quotes.author: Hank Jones
quotes.quote: In a trio context, it is imperative that you listen to what is going on.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Hank Jones, November 26-27, 2004

quotes.author: Hank Jones
quotes.quote: Maintaining technique is a daily routine. You can never get away from practicing the basics.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Hank Jones, November 26-27, 2004

quotes.author: Hank Jones
quotes.quote: My mother was a very wonderful lady.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Hank Jones, November 26-27, 2004

quotes.author: Benny Golson
quotes.quote: We were so hungry. We wanted to move ahead so bad.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Benny Golson, January 8-9, 2009

quotes.author: Nat Hentoff
quotes.quote: Jazz is very much like the Constitution in action.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Nat Hentoff, February 17-18, 2007

quotes.author: Nat Hentoff
quotes.quote: I would never play a ballad unless I knew the lyrics.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Nat Hentoff, February 17-18, 2007

quotes.author: Jim Hall
quotes.quote: This is the only thing I know how to do.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jim Hall, May 12, 2011

quotes.author: Jim Hall
quotes.quote: I have a low boredom threshold, that's part of it, I guess.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Jim Hall, May 12, 2011

quotes.author: Shirley Horn
quotes.quote: I just wanted to do the music.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Shirley Horn, June 13-14, 1996

quotes.author: Shirley Horn
quotes.quote: I'm a musician, you know, and I like to hang in with the guys and play.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Shirley Horn, June 13-14, 1996

quotes.author: J.J. Johnson
quotes.quote: I was hopeful that I could play with clarity and make a statement that had no ambiguity about it.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with J.J. Johnson, February 26-27, 1994

quotes.author: J.J. Johnson
quotes.quote: I am in awe of people who have mastered the art of teaching because it is an art unto itself.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with J.J. Johnson, February 26-27, 1994

quotes.author: J.J. Johnson
quotes.quote: It was the good life. It really was.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with J.J. Johnson, February 26-27, 1994

quotes.author: Yusef Lateef
quotes.quote: It takes time, and effort, studying, practice to sound like yourself in a convincing way, and an aesthetic way.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Yusef Lateef, June 21, 2000

quotes.author: Ramsey Lewis
quotes.quote: You start something, you finish it.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Ramsey Lewis, September 28-29, 2011

quotes.author: Chick Corea
quotes.quote: Music is a communication to me, which is life.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Chick Corea, November 5, 2012

quotes.author: Chick Corea
quotes.quote: I never had another focus in my life. I never considered doing anything else.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Chick Corea, November 5, 2012

quotes.author: Carla Bley
quotes.quote: I learned everything I ever knew working at jazz clubs and listening to the music.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Carla Bley, September 9, 2014

quotes.author: Carla Bley
quotes.quote: Now I spend my life studying music. But it's too late.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Carla Bley, September 9, 2014

quotes.author: Carla Bley
quotes.quote: I play slowly, I play with a lot of mistakes.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Jazz Oral History, NEA Jazz Master interview with Carla Bley, September 9, 2014

quotes.author: Julia Keefe
quotes.quote: With jazz there was even more freedom to be whoever I wanted to be.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Magazine, Julia Keefe's Jazz

quotes.author: Julia Keefe
quotes.quote: I had so much fun being up there improvising and performing for people and seeing their faces.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Magazine, Julia Keefe's Jazz

quotes.author: Delbert Anderson
quotes.quote: If music is busy or stressful, you're in the wrong mindset. Never lose sight of why you love music.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Magazine, Musician Delbert Anderson (National Museum of the American Indian blog), April 20, 2018

quotes.author: Delbert Anderson
quotes.quote: Always keep musically active.
quotes.source: Smithsonian Magazine, Musician Delbert Anderson (National Museum of the American Indian blog), April 20, 2018

quotes.author: Nina Simone
quotes.quote: What kept me sane was knowing that things would change, and it was a question of keeping myself together until they did.
quotes.source: I Put a Spell on You (1991)

quotes.author: Nina Simone
quotes.quote: This is the world you have made yourself, now you have to live in it.
quotes.source: I Put a Spell on You (1991)

quotes.author: Cannonball Adderley
quotes.quote: A young tenor player was complaining to me that Coleman Hawkins made him nervous. Man, I told him Hawkins was supposed to make him nervous!

quotes.author: Ornette Coleman
quotes.quote: Let's play the music and not the background!
quotes.source: "Building New Jazz; Rhythm Mode" by Hollie I. West, The Washington Post (February 14, 1971)

quotes.author: Sarah Vaughan
quotes.quote: My dream is to do whatever I want without any interference from the record company.
quotes.source: Interview, Los Angeles Times (1948)

quotes.author: Sarah Vaughan
quotes.quote: There are notes between notes, you know.
quotes.source: Interview, Los Angeles Times (1969)

quotes.author: Sarah Vaughan
quotes.quote: There's a category for me. I like to be referred to as a good singer of good songs in good taste.
quotes.source: Interview, The Hollywood Reporter (1974)

quotes.author: Sarah Vaughan
quotes.quote: When I sing, trouble can sit right on my shoulder and I don't even notice.
quotes.source: Interview, The New York Times (1988)

quotes.author: Sun Ra
quotes.quote: It takes a motion to notion and it takes a notion to motion.
quotes.source: "Tomorrow is Never" (1972)

quotes.author: Sun Ra
quotes.quote: Freedom of Speech is Freedom of Music.
quotes.source: "The Neglected Plane of Wisdom" (1966)

quotes.author: Sun Ra
quotes.quote: Music is not material. Music is Spiritual.
quotes.source: "The Neglected Plane of Wisdom" (1966)

quotes.author: Pat Metheny
quotes.quote: More and more as time has gone on, I realize that playing is really more about listening than it is about playing.
quotes.source: 'We Live Here' DVD Interview

quotes.author: Jamael Dean
quotes.quote: I want them to hear how it applies to their life. Maybe it's through a feeling they get when someone plays a certain way.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Jamael Dean's Spiritual Jazz", Nov 14, 2019

quotes.author: Theon Cross
quotes.quote: When I got to the tuba, it felt very comfortable; I'd arrived at an instrument that felt like my voice.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Theon Cross Connects Jazz With Jamaican Sound System Culture", Oct 27, 2021

quotes.author: Theon Cross
quotes.quote: Sound system culture was based on playing jazz records at the start of it, in Jamaica.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Theon Cross Connects Jazz With Jamaican Sound System Culture", Oct 27, 2021

quotes.author: Matana Roberts
quotes.quote: I want each chapter to have a different sound fabric.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "On Memphis, Matana Roberts Explores Her Family's Past", Oct 16, 2019

quotes.author: Jonah Levine
quotes.quote: I like having a mix between stuff that's written out and music that's very free and improvised.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Jazz Trombonist Jonah Levine Is Making His Own Lane In L.A.'s Rap Scene", Apr 13, 2017

quotes.author: Jonah Levine
quotes.quote: Jazz is cool. You can actually improvise.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Jazz Trombonist Jonah Levine Is Making His Own Lane In L.A.'s Rap Scene", Apr 13, 2017

quotes.author: Jonah Levine
quotes.quote: When you get outside of school and hang with people like that, they have a totally different perspective.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Jazz Trombonist Jonah Levine Is Making His Own Lane In L.A.'s Rap Scene", Apr 13, 2017

quotes.author: Eli Keszler
quotes.quote: There's a huge confusion between volume and power, and I think there's another confusion between density and speed.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "On Empire, Percussion Impresario Eli Keszler Finds His Own Natural Rhythm"

quotes.author: Eli Keszler
quotes.quote: I really wanted to create these utopian landscapes that felt devoid of people.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "On Empire, Percussion Impresario Eli Keszler Finds His Own Natural Rhythm"

quotes.author: Keith Jarrett
quotes.quote: I'm not thinking about the audience. At all. Just the music.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Keith Jarrett Speaks About Reinventing His Approach to Solo Piano, Before Carnegie Hall", Feb 13, 2017

quotes.author: Keith Jarrett
quotes.quote: It's almost impossible to avoid playing the blues sometime during a concert.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Keith Jarrett Speaks About Reinventing His Approach to Solo Piano, Before Carnegie Hall", Feb 13, 2017

quotes.author: Keith Jarrett
quotes.quote: I didn't know if I'd play again.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Keith Jarrett Speaks About Reinventing His Approach to Solo Piano, Before Carnegie Hall", Feb 13, 2017

quotes.author: Julian Lage
quotes.quote: I don't want a guitar to outlive me. I want it to sound good now.
quotes.source: WBGO, "A cycle of love and curiosity: Julian Lage's lifetime of inspiration from his elders and peers", Aug 3, 2023

quotes.author: Julian Lage
quotes.quote: The best guitar is the one you can't put down.
quotes.source: WBGO, "A cycle of love and curiosity: Julian Lage's lifetime of inspiration from his elders and peers", Aug 3, 2023

quotes.author: Julian Lage
quotes.quote: It's a cycle of love and curiosity with an instrument, not to keep you at arm's length.
quotes.source: WBGO, "A cycle of love and curiosity: Julian Lage's lifetime of inspiration from his elders and peers", Aug 3, 2023

quotes.author: Vincent Herring
quotes.quote: What's most important to me about John Coltrane was his level of creativity and originality.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Vincent Herring on the legacy and influence of John Coltrane", Dec 18, 2022

quotes.author: Vincent Herring
quotes.quote: The difference between me and Charlie Parker is creativity. I mean, that just ends it all right there.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Vincent Herring on the legacy and influence of John Coltrane", Dec 18, 2022

quotes.author: Vincent Herring
quotes.quote: I really want to get inside of Coltrane's music. The trick is trying to find a path to growth for myself.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Vincent Herring on the legacy and influence of John Coltrane", Dec 18, 2022

quotes.author: Wayne Horvitz
quotes.quote: I've basically been working with the same three ideas my whole life. And I don't really mind that.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Q&A with Wayne Horvitz: The Beauty of Implication"

quotes.author: Wayne Horvitz
quotes.quote: I'm always attracted to music that doesn't say everything, that leaves a lot to the imagination.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Q&A with Wayne Horvitz: The Beauty of Implication"

quotes.author: Wayne Horvitz
quotes.quote: Composing is something you can do and you can take a week off and when you come back, you're still a good composer.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Q&A with Wayne Horvitz: The Beauty of Implication"

quotes.author: Rafiq Bhatia
quotes.quote: Sensing the human story behind the notes is what got me into jazz in the first place.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Track By Track: Rafiq Bhatia, Standards, Vol. 1"

quotes.author: Rafiq Bhatia
quotes.quote: All of these artists have a sound that's iconic because it's personal.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Track By Track: Rafiq Bhatia, Standards, Vol. 1"

quotes.author: Rafiq Bhatia
quotes.quote: There's something magical about the sound of being musically present in a given moment.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Track By Track: Rafiq Bhatia, Standards, Vol. 1"

quotes.author: Oran Etkin
quotes.quote: It's really about connections. The connections with the people that I meet in different places and creating connections between these different places.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Oran Etkin's global jazz journeys and the magic of Timbalooloo", Jun 27, 2024

quotes.author: Anna Webber
quotes.quote: I really just want to make sure that I'm writing honest music, and not just a sample platter of a bunch of different things.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "On Idiom, Anna Webber Merges Improvisation With Composition", May 25, 2021

quotes.author: Anna Webber
quotes.quote: I really wanted to try to bring those things closer together.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "On Idiom, Anna Webber Merges Improvisation With Composition", May 25, 2021

quotes.author: William Parker
quotes.quote: If we play soft enough you can hear the entire universe.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "William Parker Accentuates the Free in Free Jazz", Jan 19, 2021

quotes.author: William Parker
quotes.quote: You take your time and you go back and you listen to some more and then something else is slowly revealed about the music.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "William Parker Accentuates the Free in Free Jazz", Jan 19, 2021

quotes.author: William Parker
quotes.quote: It's not about trying to be avant-garde or folk, it's not about a style.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "William Parker Accentuates the Free in Free Jazz", Jan 19, 2021

quotes.author: James Blood Ulmer
quotes.quote: That tuning freed me. I could play without following or copying anybody.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Jazz Legend James Blood Ulmer Walks the Line Between Melody and Improv", Oct 17, 2017

quotes.author: James Blood Ulmer
quotes.quote: You don't play music without a composition.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Jazz Legend James Blood Ulmer Walks the Line Between Melody and Improv", Oct 17, 2017

quotes.author: James Blood Ulmer
quotes.quote: Ornette loved the way my guitar sounded then. He knew I was free.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Jazz Legend James Blood Ulmer Walks the Line Between Melody and Improv", Oct 17, 2017

quotes.author: Joshua Abrams
quotes.quote: We make the music we want to make, and it will do what it needs to do.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Joshua Abrams is a Focused Force in Jazz and Film Scoring", May 16, 2017

quotes.author: Joshua Abrams
quotes.quote: I write compositions that are meant to have improvisation within them. It's not a static thing.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Joshua Abrams is a Focused Force in Jazz and Film Scoring", May 16, 2017

quotes.author: Joshua Abrams
quotes.quote: I like to describe our music as a sonic environment that a listener can dwell in if they are so inclined.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Joshua Abrams is a Focused Force in Jazz and Film Scoring", May 16, 2017

quotes.author: Moses Boyd
quotes.quote: I think it's very important to experiment and try things outside of your normality.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Moses Boyd Is An Old Soul At The Forefront of U.K. Jazz", Aug 10, 2017

quotes.author: Moses Boyd
quotes.quote: Tony is a massive influence who changed the way I perceived how drums can and should be played.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Moses Boyd Is An Old Soul At The Forefront of U.K. Jazz", Aug 10, 2017

quotes.author: Joe Armon-Jones
quotes.quote: It's a collaborative thing always. I knew where I wanted the songs to go, but I can't get them there without the people involved.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Joe Armon-Jones Captures the Pluralistic Grooves of Modern London Jazz", May 31, 2018

quotes.author: Corey Fonville
quotes.quote: Every time we play, we sound different. It's important to capture that as much as we can.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "How Butcher Brown Bring Their Raw Live Energy to the Studio", Oct 9, 2018

quotes.author: Corey Fonville
quotes.quote: You've got to be a hybrid these days. We're a product of our environment today.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "How Butcher Brown Bring Their Raw Live Energy to the Studio", Oct 9, 2018

quotes.author: Daniel Herskedal
quotes.quote: I always try to make new soundscapes. Before I do the compositions, I imagine the overall sound I want for the album.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Tuba Player and Composer Daniel Herskedal Bridges Worlds on The Roc", Mar 31, 2017

quotes.author: Daniel Herskedal
quotes.quote: I try to write for every musician, but also let them play with it and improvise, as well.
quotes.source: Bandcamp Daily, "Tuba Player and Composer Daniel Herskedal Bridges Worlds on The Roc", Mar 31, 2017

quotes.author: Sean Jones
quotes.quote: I actually try not to play notes. I try to play human utterances.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Trumpeter and educator Sean Jones: 'It's up to us to lift one another up'", Mar 1, 2024

quotes.author: Sean Jones
quotes.quote: It's up to us to lift one another up, it's up to us to immerse ourselves in the communities.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Trumpeter and educator Sean Jones: 'It's up to us to lift one another up'", Mar 1, 2024

quotes.author: Sean Jones
quotes.quote: I have failed multiple times in my life. I just don't allow those mistakes to define me.
quotes.source: WBGO, "Trumpeter and educator Sean Jones: 'It's up to us to lift one another up'", Mar 1, 2024

quotes.author: Rudresh Mahanthappa
quotes.quote: There's no reason a Charlie Parker tune and a Wayne Shorter tune and a Mike Formanek tune can't all be on the same program.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Q&A with Rudresh Mahanthappa: A Jazz Festival Grows in Princeton"

quotes.author: Rudresh Mahanthappa
quotes.quote: I would love it if my students could play 'Giant Steps' in all 12 keys, but more importantly, they can talk about the historical context.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Q&A with Rudresh Mahanthappa: A Jazz Festival Grows in Princeton"

quotes.author: Rudresh Mahanthappa
quotes.quote: Having people who are really part of the current state of this art form is essential.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Q&A with Rudresh Mahanthappa: A Jazz Festival Grows in Princeton"

quotes.author: Aengus Hackett
quotes.quote: When I discovered jazz, I was blown away because to me, it seemed like this was the one music that could express everything.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Q&A, Aengus Hackett: Exploring the Music of Jazz Legends in Galway, Ireland"

quotes.author: Aengus Hackett
quotes.quote: In a place like Galway, if somebody wants to sit in, and if they can actually play, they're generally welcome to do so.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Q&A, Aengus Hackett: Exploring the Music of Jazz Legends in Galway, Ireland"

quotes.author: Aengus Hackett
quotes.quote: I was drawn to music that expressed certain things, certain emotions.
quotes.source: JAZZIZ, "Q&A, Aengus Hackett: Exploring the Music of Jazz Legends in Galway, Ireland"

quotes.author: Jimmy Cobb
quotes.quote: Wes was another genius. He sat there and played all that stuff with his thumb. That's genius right there.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Jimmy Cobb (Part Three), 2008

quotes.author: Jimmy Cobb
quotes.quote: You've got to be ready when it comes.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Jimmy Cobb (Part Three), 2008

quotes.author: Jimmy Cobb
quotes.quote: I just liked being in the best jazz band in the world at the time.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Jimmy Cobb (Part Two), 2008

quotes.author: Jimmy Cobb
quotes.quote: It was always fun to record with them guys because, you know, look who you got man.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Jimmy Cobb (Part Two), 2008

quotes.author: Benny Golson
quotes.quote: My mother would have gone to the wall for me, and she often did.
quotes.source: JazzWax, Interview: Benny Golson (Part 1), September 2008

quotes.author: Benny Golson
quotes.quote: I'm a big believer that a title should convey something about the song before you hear it.
quotes.source: JazzWax, Interview: Benny Golson (Part 1), September 2008

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: Did I play the best I could? Did I help these guys play better because I'm standing here?
quotes.source: JazzWax, Interview: Ron Carter (Part 4), March 2008

quotes.author: Ron Carter
quotes.quote: We were just all sharing the same problem—how to go from point A to point B.
quotes.source: JazzWax, Interview: Ron Carter (Part 4), March 2008

quotes.author: Wayne Shorter
quotes.quote: Music has a sense of velocity in it. There's also a sense of mystery.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Wayne Shorter, 2008

quotes.author: Wayne Shorter
quotes.quote: I don't like words like beginning and end. We lean on them for our sanity, but they are artificial.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Wayne Shorter, 2008

quotes.author: Wayne Shorter
quotes.quote: Everything is connected. Playing music, to me, reflects what's happening and what's not happening.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Wayne Shorter, 2008

quotes.author: Bobby Sanabria
quotes.quote: I just love playing and performing. That is the only thing I can tell you.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Bobby Sanabria, 2008

quotes.author: Bobby Sanabria
quotes.quote: The drummer drives, everybody else rides.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Bobby Sanabria, 2008

quotes.author: Miguel Zenón
quotes.quote: My music has definitely evolved and I feel that I have grown as a composer, an artist, and a saxophone player.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Miguel Zenón, 2008

quotes.author: Miguel Zenón
quotes.quote: I hope to keep making music for as long as I can and I really appreciate everybody that has enjoyed anything we have done.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Miguel Zenón, 2008

quotes.author: Hank Jones
quotes.quote: I never played anyone's solos just as they had. For me it's the style which is important.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, OctoJAZZarian Profile: Hank Jones, 2008

quotes.author: Hank Jones
quotes.quote: The whole idea of improvisation is to induce some creativity. If there's no creativity there's no improvisation.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, OctoJAZZarian Profile: Hank Jones, 2008

quotes.author: Hank Jones
quotes.quote: I regret that I didn't know Tatum for a longer period of time. I wish I'd known him sooner.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, OctoJAZZarian Profile: Hank Jones, 2008

quotes.author: Johnny Griffin
quotes.quote: Being from Chicago, there was always this competition between New York and Chicago.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Johnny Griffin, 2008

quotes.author: Johnny Griffin
quotes.quote: To me, Lester Young was the trunk of the swing tree.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Johnny Griffin, 2008

quotes.author: Vijay Iyer
quotes.quote: My mission is not to play Indian music. Its not what I need out of music.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Vijay Iyer, 2008

quotes.author: Vijay Iyer
quotes.quote: The rhythm is the underpinning of the way you experience it.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Vijay Iyer, 2008

quotes.author: Vijay Iyer
quotes.quote: We sit at the crossroads of all these different streams and we just need to make sense of it.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Vijay Iyer, 2008

quotes.author: Andrea Brachfeld
quotes.quote: I truly believe in the law of attraction. Maybe I am not gigging all the time but I am always busy doing tons of things.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Andrea Brachfeld, 2008

quotes.author: Andrea Brachfeld
quotes.quote: When I play its not me playing per se; I mean I am playing the flute but the music is coming through me.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Andrea Brachfeld, 2008

quotes.author: Andrea Brachfeld
quotes.quote: My dream has always been to write music and have wonderful musicians play it and that started to happen ten years ago.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Andrea Brachfeld, 2008

quotes.author: Randy Weston
quotes.quote: There is so much more to be heard so why stop now.
