quotes.source: Jazz.com, OctoJAZZarian Profile: Randy Weston, 2008

quotes.author: Randy Weston
quotes.quote: The slaves came here with nothing; their freedom, their instruments, their communication were taken from them. And yet the music survived.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, OctoJAZZarian Profile: Randy Weston, 2008

quotes.author: Randy Weston
quotes.quote: We are responsible to give something back to our homeland, Africa.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, OctoJAZZarian Profile: Randy Weston, 2008

quotes.author: Chick Corea
quotes.quote: Music is communication. This is an aspect of life and of art that is not often taught in schools.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Chick Corea, 2008

quotes.author: Chick Corea
quotes.quote: The one thing in art and in communication that will never change is that you have someone entertaining someone.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Chick Corea, 2008

quotes.author: Esperanza Spalding
quotes.quote: Jazz ain't nothing but soul and it's true. We put our hearts and soul into the music.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Esperanza Spalding, 2008

quotes.author: Esperanza Spalding
quotes.quote: Everybody should read and everybody should think more than they read.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Esperanza Spalding, 2008

quotes.author: Brad Mehldau
quotes.quote: Comping in jazz is very difficult to teach in a lesson, because its a social thing, an intuitive thing, something that you gain from experience.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Brad Mehldau, 2008

quotes.author: Brad Mehldau
quotes.quote: Nothing can replace the experience of watching a piano player comp behind a soloist.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Brad Mehldau, 2008

quotes.author: Dianne Reeves
quotes.quote: I guess I'm a singer first. I like to write songs, but I like more than anything to find songs that really address my life.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Dianne Reeves, 2008

quotes.author: Nicholas Payton
quotes.quote: I wanted to try to create music that was beautiful, a music of simplicity, elegance and grace, yet very sophisticated at the same time.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Nicholas Payton, 2008

quotes.author: Nicholas Payton
quotes.quote: Sound is the most important thing. Thats what people feel, thats what people hear, and thats your spiritual energy.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Nicholas Payton, 2008

quotes.author: Nicholas Payton
quotes.quote: For me, at this point, its all about love. I dont want anything to take me out of that energy.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Nicholas Payton, 2008

quotes.author: Uri Caine
quotes.quote: I hear the groove in Mozart. I love Stravinsky.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Uri Caine, 2008

quotes.author: Mark Elf
quotes.quote: If you can play, if you have the ability to be creative and you can play something then you just write what you play.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Mark Elf, 2008

quotes.author: Arturo O'Farrill
quotes.quote: When youre a kid you reject everything. I was into bebop and free jazz.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Arturo O'Farrill, 2008

quotes.author: Arturo O'Farrill
quotes.quote: You only have one lifetime to give it all away. If you dont, then you have failed.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Arturo O'Farrill, 2008

quotes.author: Charlie Haden
quotes.quote: Country music is very dear to my heart. It's beautiful music with beautiful harmonies and beautiful melodies.
quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Charlie Haden, 2008

quotes.author: Charlie Haden

quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Matthew Shipp, 2008

quotes.source: Jazz.com, In Conversation with Matthew Shipp, 2008

quotes.source: London Jazz News, INTERVIEW: Tom Arthurs, 10 Oct 2016

quotes.source: London Jazz News, #IWD2020: Fanny Ménégoz, flautist, 7 Mar 2020

quotes.source: Jazz Views, Maggie Nicols interview, 12 May 2026

quotes.source: Jazz Views, Tim Armacost: Taking On the Inevitable, 1 Mar 2023

quotes.source: Jazz Views, Jan Hammer: A Life in Jazz, 23 Jun 2023

quotes.source: London Jazz News, INTERVIEW: Nathalie Loriers, 8 Sep 2015

quotes.source: London Jazz News, INTERVIEW: Nathalie Loriers, 8 Sep 2015

quotes.source: London Jazz News, INTERVIEW: Dick Oatts, 31 Mar 2018

quotes.source: London Jazz News, INTERVIEW: Dick Oatts, 31 Mar 2018

quotes.source: London Jazz News, #IWD2020: Areni Agbabian, 4 Mar 2020

quotes.source: London Jazz News, #IWD2020: Areni Agbabian, 4 Mar 2020

quotes.source: Jazz Views, Max Middleton: Jazz, Jeff And More, 24 Aug 2023

quotes.source: Jazz Views, Yumi Ito interview, 29 Sep 2025

quotes.source: Jazz Views, Becca Wilkins interview, 12 Jun 2025

quotes.source: Jazz Views, Anders Hagberg interview, 30 Oct 2025

quotes.source: Jazz Views, Anders Hagberg interview, 30 Oct 2025

quotes.source: London Jazz News, Mondays With Morgan: Jim Snidero, 19 Feb 2024

quotes.source: London Jazz News, Interview with Guillermo Rozenthuler, 12 Oct 2020

quotes.source: London Jazz News, INTERVIEW/PREVIEW: Laila Biali, 5 Nov 2018

quotes.source: London Jazz News, Preview/Interview: Emily Saunders, 23 Jun 2017
